title: New mRNA Vaccine Shows Success in Skin Cancer Trial
subtitle: A new personalized treatment helps the immune system fight melanoma, offering hope for future cancer care.

summary.en: Pharmaceutical companies Merck and Moderna have announced positive results from a large-scale clinical trial for a new skin cancer vaccine. The treatment uses mRNA technology to create a personalized vaccine for each patient. By training the immune system to recognize cancer cells, the vaccine helps prevent the disease from returning after surgery. While experts call this a significant breakthrough, they emphasize that the full study results still need to be reviewed. The companies are now looking into whether this technology can be used to treat other types of cancer.
summary.zh: 製藥公司默克與莫德納宣布了一項針對新型皮膚癌疫苗的大規模臨床試驗，結果正面。該療法利用信使核糖核酸技術，為每位患者量身打造個人化疫苗。透過訓練免疫系統辨識癌細胞，該疫苗有助於預防手術後的癌症復發。儘管專家稱此為重大突破，但仍強調完整的研究結果尚待審查。目前這些公司正研究此技術是否能用於治療其他類型的癌症。

paragraphs.en: A new medical development has brought fresh hope to the field of cancer treatment. Pharmaceutical companies Merck and Moderna recently announced that a personalized vaccine, used alongside an existing drug, has successfully stopped skin cancer from returning in patients. This trial focused on melanoma, a serious type of skin cancer, and is being described by many as a major step forward in modern medicine.
paragraphs.zh: 一項新的醫療進展為癌症治療領域帶來了新的希望。製藥公司默克 (Merck) 與莫德納 (Moderna) 近期宣布，一種結合現有藥物使用的個人化疫苗，已成功防止患者的皮膚癌復發。這項試驗針對的是一種嚴重的皮膚癌——黑色素瘤，許多人將此視為現代醫學的一大進步。

paragraphs.en: The vaccine, known as Intismeran, is designed to be used after a patient has had surgery to remove their tumor. According to the BBC, the trial involved more than 1,000 patients with high-risk melanoma. The results showed that patients who received both the vaccine and an immunotherapy drug called Keytruda stayed cancer-free for a longer time than those who only received the drug. Immunotherapy is a type of treatment that helps the body's own immune system fight diseases like cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 這種名為 Intismeran 的疫苗，設計用於患者手術切除腫瘤後。根據英國廣播公司 (BBC) 報導，該試驗涉及超過一千名高風險黑色素瘤患者。結果顯示，同時接受疫苗與一種名為吉舒達 (Keytruda) 免疫療法藥物的患者，其無癌存活時間比僅接受藥物治療的患者更長。免疫療法是一種協助人體自身免疫系統對抗癌症等疾病的治療方式。

paragraphs.en: This new vaccine is unique because it is personalized. According to NPR, scientists create the vaccine by looking at the specific DNA of a patient's tumor. They use mRNA technology—the same technology used in some COVID-19 vaccines—to teach the patient's immune system to identify and attack any remaining cancer cells. Dr. Robert Vonderheide, a cancer expert at Penn Medicine, explained to NPR that the vaccine works by activating the immune system to generate T-cells, which are specialized cells that hunt down and destroy cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 這款新疫苗的獨特之處在於其個人化特性。根據美國國家公共廣播電台 (NPR) 報導，科學家透過檢視患者腫瘤的特定去氧核糖核酸 (DNA) 來製作疫苗。他們運用信使核糖核酸 (mRNA) 技術——即部分新冠肺炎疫苗所使用的相同技術——來教導患者的免疫系統辨識並攻擊殘留的癌細胞。賓州大學醫學院 (Penn Medicine) 的癌症專家羅伯特·馮德海德 (Robert Vonderheide) 博士向 NPR 解釋，該疫苗的作用在於活化免疫系統以產生 T 細胞，這些特化細胞能追蹤並摧毀癌細胞。

paragraphs.en: Experts in the medical community have reacted to the news with excitement. Prof. Peter Johnson, the National Clinical Director for Cancer at NHS England, told the BBC that this is an important advance. He noted that while previous treatments have focused on generally boosting the immune system, this new approach is much more specific. By targeting the unique mutations in a patient's tumor, the treatment can be more effective. Stephane Bancel, the chief executive of Moderna, called the findings a "pivotal moment" for cancer research.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學界專家對此消息反應熱烈。英國國家醫療保健服務 (NHS) 英格蘭癌症臨床主任彼得·強森 (Peter Johnson) 教授告訴 BBC，這是一項重要的進展。他指出，雖然過去的治療多集中在全面提升免疫系統，但這種新方法更具針對性。透過鎖定患者腫瘤中獨特的突變，治療效果可以更顯著。莫德納執行長史蒂芬·班塞爾 (Stephane Bancel) 將此研究結果稱為癌症研究的「關鍵時刻」。

paragraphs.en: Despite the positive news, experts are urging the public to remain cautious. Dr. Talisia Quallo from Cancer Research UK noted that while the research shows great promise, the full results of the study have not yet been released or checked by independent experts. This process, known as peer review, is a standard part of medical science to ensure that findings are accurate and reliable. Furthermore, even if the vaccine is proven to be safe and effective, it would still need to go through a long approval process by government regulators before it could be given to patients in hospitals.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管消息正面，專家仍呼籲大眾保持審慎。英國癌症研究協會 (Cancer Research UK) 的塔莉西亞·夸洛 (Talisia Quallo) 博士指出，雖然該研究展現了極大潛力，但完整的研究結果尚未公開，也尚未經過獨立專家的審查。這種稱為同儕審查的程序，是醫學科學確保研究結果準確且可靠的標準步驟。此外，即便疫苗被證實安全有效，在能提供給醫院患者使用前，仍需經過政府監管機構漫長的審核程序。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the potential for this technology goes beyond skin cancer. Merck and Moderna are already testing similar personalized vaccines for other conditions, including lung, bladder, and kidney cancers. As noted by STAT News, many experts believe that 2026 will be remembered as one of the most important years for cancer treatment because of these new developments.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，這項技術的潛力不僅限於皮膚癌。默克與莫德納已在測試針對其他病症的類似個人化疫苗，包括肺癌、膀胱癌與腎臟癌。正如 STAT 新聞網所指出的，許多專家認為，由於這些新進展，二零二六年將被銘記為癌症治療史上最重要的年份之一。

paragraphs.en: For now, the focus remains on the ongoing trial. Researchers are continuing to follow the patients to see how the vaccine affects their long-term survival. As Dr. Vonderheide explained to NPR, the goal is to ensure that patients have the best chance of living without the cancer coming back. While there are still questions to answer, such as the exact strength of the immune response and any potential safety concerns, the early results are being viewed as a significant success. As research continues to be funded, the hope is that more patients will eventually have access to these personalized treatment options, helping them live longer and healthier lives.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，焦點仍放在持續進行的試驗上。研究人員正持續追蹤患者，以觀察疫苗對其長期存活率的影響。正如馮德海德博士向 NPR 解釋的，目標是確保患者有最大的機會在癌症不復發的情況下生活。雖然仍有問題待解，例如免疫反應的確切強度以及任何潛在的安全疑慮，但初步結果已被視為一項重大成功。隨著研究持續獲得資金挹注，人們期望未來能有更多患者獲得這些個人化治療選項，協助他們活得更長久、更健康。

quiz.question: According to the article, when is the Intismeran vaccine typically administered to a patient?

options.A: Before the surgical removal of the tumor.
options.B: After the patient has undergone surgery to remove the tumor.
options.C: Instead of using traditional immunotherapy drugs.
options.D: During the initial diagnosis of high-risk melanoma.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第二段明確指出「The vaccine, known as Intismeran, is designed to be used after a patient has had surgery to remove their tumor.」選項 A 錯誤，因為手術後才使用；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到是與免疫療法藥物合併使用而非替代；選項 D 錯誤，文中未提及在診斷初期即使用。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the current status of the Intismeran vaccine?

options.A: It is already widely available for all cancer patients in hospitals.
options.B: It has been proven to be 100% effective against all types of skin cancer.
options.C: It requires further verification before it can be considered a standard medical treatment.
options.D: It has failed to receive support from the medical community due to safety concerns.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，專家提醒研究結果尚未經過同儕審查（peer review），且即便有效，仍需經過政府監管機構漫長的審批程序。選項 A 錯誤，因為尚未正式核准；選項 B 錯誤，文中僅提到對黑色素瘤有正面進展，並未宣稱 100% 有效；選項 D 錯誤，專家對此研究持正面態度，僅是保持審慎。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'pivotal' mean in the context of Stephane Bancel's quote?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第四段中，Moderna 執行長將此發現稱為「pivotal moment」，意指這是一個關鍵的轉折點，對癌症研究具有決定性的影響。選項 B 錯誤，文中未強調速度；選項 C 錯誤，此處是指正面的重大進展而非爭議；選項 D 錯誤，該技術涉及複雜的 mRNA 與 DNA 分析，並非簡單。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the new cancer vaccine?

options.A: The vaccine is a guaranteed cure that will eliminate the need for surgery.
options.B: The vaccine represents a promising, personalized approach that could transform cancer treatment.
options.C: The vaccine is primarily designed to replace existing immunotherapy drugs like Keytruda.
options.D: The vaccine is currently only being tested on patients with lung and kidney cancer.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。全文主旨旨在介紹這項結合 mRNA 技術與個人化醫療的疫苗，強調其在黑色素瘤治療上的成功及其對未來癌症治療的潛在影響。選項 A 誇大了療效；選項 C 與文中提到的「合併使用」相違背；選項 D 錯誤，目前主要試驗對象為黑色素瘤，其他癌症僅是未來測試的方向。
